'''Cormaed''' is a village in [[Altara]], located on the [[River Eldar]].

When searching for [[Gareth Bryne]], [[Morgase Trakand]], [[Lini Eltring]], [[Martyn Tallanvor]], [[Basel Gill]], [[Breane Taborwin]] and [[Lamgwin Dorn]] travel from [[Sehar]] to Cormaed to find a ferry that will take them across the Eldar into [[Amadicia]].{{ref/book|5|56}}
